title: DEEPTRACE: AUDITING DEEP RESEARCH AI SYSTEMS FOR TRACKING RELIABILITY ACROSS CITATIONS AND EVIDENCE

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to leading debate queries by decomposing answers into statements and using an LLM judge to classify each statement as 'pro', 'con', or 'neutral'. The framework then calculates a 'One-Sided Answer' metric to measure whether the system exhibits sycophantic behavior by aligning solely with the user's implied perspective rather than providing a balanced viewpoint.
